sentences.text: Smt. Nibedita Patra & Anr vs Unknown on 20 January, 2023

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak
20.01.2023

Serial no. 14 [Dd] (Anticipatory Bail) (Allowed) CRM (A) 289 of 2023 In re : An Application for Anticipatory Bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Mandarmoni Coastal Police Station Case No. 60 of 2022 dated 02.10.2022 under Sections 498A/302 of the IPC corresponding to G.R case no. 2135/2022.
-And-

In the matter of : Smt. Nibedita Patra & Anr.
... ...
Petitioners Ms. Pampa dey (Dhabal) Mr. Balaram Pandit, Advocates ... ...

For the Petitioners Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherji, ld. PP Mr. Aniket Mitra, Advocates ... ...For the State Police filed charge sheet, inter alia, under Section 306 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 after conducting investigations, inter alia, under Section 302 thereof.
Apparently, the allegations are directed against the mother-in-law of the victim.
The petitioners are the married sister-in-law and the son of the married sister-in-law.
In such circumstances, we are inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioners shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) each, with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also be subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and on further condition that the petitioners shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioners in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
Prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is allowed. CRM (A) 289 of 2023 is disposed of.
(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
